what: SKEW: vol_trail live path returns window-unfilled (fail-permissive, never fires) whenever the monitor's candle frame ends on a forming bar. src/main.py:623 fetches limit=200; trail_vol.resolve_vol_trail_mult and trail_vol_shadow drop the forming bar -> 199 closed bars < vol_pctl_window 200 -> atr_pctl_closed null. MEASURED 2026-10-05..08, ada_pullback_2h, 76 shadow rows / 26 closed bars / 2 packages: 56 of 76 rows (73.7%) null-closed, and 56 of 56 coincide with raw_last_bar_open_ts != closed_bar_open_ts; 20 of 20 non-null rows are the same-bar ticks. 7 null rows had raw pctl > 0.9 and an offline closed pctl > 0.9 (harness would tighten, live would not); 6 of 26 closed bars never got a closed-bar evaluation. Declared lever would fire only on ticks where no forming bar is visible, not on every closed bar as the backtest assumes. Proposed fix (Tier-2 order/monitor path): fetch limit >= vol_pctl_window+2 (e.g. 210) for monitors of legs declaring vol_trail, or let resolve_vol_trail_mult request more history. Fix before or with #17193.
